2.text: Nori is your reliable guide to the world of foreign languages. It's convenient, no matter your level. Designed for anyone who wants to improve their language skills, Nori helps you save and remember new words and their translations, making language learning more engaging and effective.

punkts.1: Simple interface: an intuitive, easy-to-use interface makes working with the app as comfortable as possible.
punkts.2: Save words: add new words and their translations to your database with a single tap.

4.text: Don't put off your learning. With Nori you can start your path to language fluency right now!
